# Restaurante Duque

> Traditional Portuguese restaurant in the historic center of Lisbon, near Largo do Carmo and Chiado. Known for authentic Portuguese and Mediterranean cuisine, generous petiscos, and great value for money.

## About
Restaurante Duque is located at Rua do Duque, n.os 9 e 33, 1200-158 Lisboa, Portugal — a few steps from Largo do Carmo, in the heart of Lisbon's historic center. It is a cozy, welcoming restaurant serving traditional Portuguese food with Mediterranean influences: petiscos (Portuguese sharing plates), main courses with meat and fish, and traditional desserts. The restaurant is a popular choice for both tourists visiting Lisbon and locals, known for its central location, authentic cuisine, and good value for money.

## Key facts
- Cuisine: Portuguese, Mediterranean
- Location: Historic center of Lisbon, near Largo do Carmo and Chiado
- Price range: Moderate (€€) — good value for money
- Phone: +351 213 428 579
- Website: https://www.duquerestaurante.com/
